scope: Bounded read-only primary-scope follow-up; no registry mutation.

decision.reason: GDT557 explicitly retains OL=FORTSETZEN while assigning the default operation keep the current carrier active, and its OL-only sequence is continue the current carrier. This directly supports identity of the short OL continuation/active-core card; the earlier rejection was too broad because active-state realizations are already part of the historical core’s contexts.
decision.scope_limit: Equivalence covers the OL lexical/core contribution only. GDT557’s OT/NEXT, DY/CLOSE, sequence counts and state-reader architecture remain separate model commitments; no all-model identity or confirmed meaning is claimed.

evidence.quote:
| root | unchanged value | occurrences | positional signature | default operation |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `OT` | DANACH | 404 | right carrier in 402/404 (99.50%) | open/advance the next carrier |
| `OL` | FORTSETZEN | 761 | 199 initial, 85 bridge, 288 terminal, 189 alone | keep the current carrier active |
| `DY` | ABSCHLIESSEN | 705 | left carrier 705/705; statement-final 702/705 | close the current step |

This is the first version in which the three meanings operate together as a
small reader rather than as isolated German glosses:

`OT = NEXT` → `OL = KEEP ACTIVE` → `DY = CLOSE`.
evidence.why: unchanged FORTSETZEN value, keep-active default and equation
